sloka: जगर्जुश्च प्रणेदुश्च चिक्षिपुश्चापि सायकान्।जगृहुश्चापि ते वीरा निर्यान्तो युद्धदुर्मदाः ।। ६.६९.३९ ।।
transliteration: jagarjuśca praṇeduśca cikṣipuścāpi sāyakān।jagṛhuścāpi te vīrā niryānto yuddhadurmadāḥ ।। 6.69.39 ।।

translations.english: Departing from there the Rakshasa army saw Vanara army ready with many rocks.
